# Font test fixtures

`space-grotesk-latin-wght-normal.woff2` is the Latin variable `wght` face of
[Space Grotesk](https://fontsource.org/fonts/space-grotesk), downloaded from
Fontsource:

```text
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/space-grotesk:vf@5.3.0/latin-wght-normal.woff2
```

The font is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The full license text
is `OFL.txt`, copied from:

```text
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk@5.3.0/LICENSE
```

The fixture is used only by the font manifest, capture, and determinism tests.
